title: Crashed Thargoid Scout #1
excerpt: A crashed Thargoid Scout can be found on HIP 17125 body A 3 a, located at -65.1570, 47.4684 (in Live/4.0) or at -65.8248, 48.8649 (in Legacy/3.8). The crash site is surrounded by Thargoid Technology Samples, Thargoid Biological Matter, and Thargoid Resin. The buried nature of the ship makes it difficult to target with your SRV’s…
